The builder draws each line's `vis`; the only on-screen words are `card` and `signs` (and the captions of `say`). v2 (Nolan 11/13 after the preview: 'yt should be shorter... I would like more jokes'): five joke additions to the TikTok cut (j3, j5, j7b new, j9, j12) and a shorter YouTube cut `yt_lines` (about 33 s, mild words). _rules: Jokes aim at Jensen Huang's own admitted conduct and at Meatball. No woman is named or joked about; nothing about his family. Unproven claims stay attributed. The line that names a country is clean. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: The Jensen Huang allegations, explained. Buckle up, it's a mess.
lines.vis: Frame 0: cartoon Jensen (black leather jacket, silver hair, glasses) on a keynote stage in a spotlight, holding a graphics card up like a trophy, already moving. Meatball hops in small at the side with a news mic.

lines.say: He ran Nvidia. Never took off that leather jacket. Everything else? Different fucking story.
lines.vis: Jensen struts across the stage; the jacket gets its own little sparkle. On 'Everything else' he freezes, sweat drop, tugs his collar.

lines.say: November eighth, he emailed Nvidia employees: I was unfaithful to my wife... I am deeply sorry. Worst all-staff email since whoever microwaved the fish.
card: HIS EMAIL TO STAFF, NOV 8 (NVIDIA NEWSROOM)
lines.vis: Office. Jensen at a laptop presses a huge SEND key; an envelope flies out and multiplies across the screen. On the fish joke a tiny microwave dings beside Meatball and he pinches his nose.

lines.say: He built a chip empire and still couldn't manage his own hardware.
lines.vis: Jensen holds the graphics card; its fans spin up, it smokes and sparks; he looks down at it, mortified.

lines.say: Meatball read the email to his cat, Sauce. Sauce left the room. Tough damn crowd.
lines.vis: Meatball's living room. Meatball reads a phone aloud with the news mic; the orange cat, Sauce, turns and walks out of frame.

lines.say: It broke October twenty-ninth: the New York Times reported U.S. officials believe an executive he was close to was spying for China.
lines.vis: A newspaper front page slides in (blank lines for text, the card carries the words). Jensen reads it and the graphics card slips out of his hand. No woman is drawn.

lines.say: The same report said officials didn't believe he knew. Neither of them has been charged. China calls it a smear.
lines.vis: Three stamps land one after another on the newspaper: OFFICIALS: HE DIDN'T KNOW (NYT), NO CHARGES, CHINA DENIES. Jensen wipes his forehead.

lines.say: Meatball can't relate. He can't even get a text back.
lines.vis: Meatball's living room: Meatball stares at his phone, nothing arrives; a tumbleweed rolls past. Sauce is not in this one.

lines.say: Monday, Nvidia lost about 190 billion dollars in market value, Reuters reported. Most expensive side quest in fucking history.
lines.vis: A giant stock chart; the line falls off a cliff and Jensen rides it down like a slide, jacket flapping. Meatball watches with popcorn.

lines.say: Then the Times and Reuters reported more affairs, not confirmed. If true, that's serious fucking multithreading, more tabs open than Chrome.
card: MORE AFFAIRS REPORTED (NYT NOV 11, REUTERS NOV 12)
lines.vis: More newspapers pile up on Jensen until only the jacket collar and glasses show. A little CPU with many glowing threads spins on 'multithreading'. On the tabs joke a row of little browser tabs pops open over his head, one after another (blank tabs, no words).

lines.say: A November twelfth filing: he resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately.
lines.vis: Back on the stage: Jensen sets the graphics card on the podium, hangs his badge on the mic stand and walks off; the spotlight stays on the empty stage.

lines.say: He used to say: the more you buy, the more you save. Now it's: the more you stray, the more you pay.
card: "THE MORE YOU BUY, THE MORE YOU SAVE"
THE MORE YOU STRAY, THE MORE YOU PAY
lines.vis: A keynote slide with the first line; it flips over to the second with a cash-register ding. Jensen facepalms.

lines.say: Interim CEO: finance chief Colette Kress. Meatball sent in his resume anyway. Skills: keeps it in his pants.
lines.vis: An office door with a fresh INTERIM CEO sign being hung. Nobody else real is drawn. Meatball tiptoes up and slides a crayon resume under the door; it slides straight back out. On 'Skills' Meatball gives a proud thumbs-up; the resume still slides back out.

lines.say: Three House committee chairs reportedly asked for a closed-door briefing. Closed doors. That's how this shit started.
lines.vis: Huge double doors slam shut; Jensen stands outside them, sweating. On 'Closed doors' Meatball gives the camera a slow look.

lines.say: So which part broke your brain? Because
card: WHICH PART BROKE YOUR BRAIN? COMMENT
lines.vis: Back to the frame-0 stage and pose so the loop into j1 is seamless; the question sits in a top-corner pill.
